# forgejoctl CLI surface snapshot
# Generated by scripts/verify_skill_sync.py --update

## forgejoctl --help
```text
Typed Forgejo control plane for agent swarms

Usage: forgejo-agent [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  repo    
  issue   
  worker  
  whoami  
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>          
      --token-file <TOKEN_FILE>  
  -h, --help                     Print help
  -V, --version                  Print version
```

      --workdir <WORKDIR>

      --execute                      
      --once                         
      --close-on-success             
  -h, --help                         Print help
